name: human-gate
description: Holds irreversible tool calls (deploy, publish, push to main, money, outbound messages, destructive SQL) for a person, so auto mode and allow rules cannot approve them, and lets read-only calls through without a prompt.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Comma-separated categories held for a person: deploy, publish, push-main, money, outbound, data. Empty means all.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names a push to is held. Empty means main, master, production, prod, release.

extraCommands.title: Extra Bash patterns
extraCommands.description: Comma-separated regex sources; a Bash command segment matching one is held, e.g. \bansible-playbook\b

extraTools.title: Extra tool patterns
extraTools.description: Comma-separated regex sources on tool names, e.g. ^mcp__linear__save_issue$

readOnlyFastLane.title: Read-only fast lane
readOnlyFastLane.description: Allow calls the tool marks read-only without a prompt (a deny or ask rule in settings still wins).

trustMcpReadOnly.title: Trust MCP read-only
trustMcpReadOnly.description: Include MCP tools in the fast lane. Off by default: an MCP tool's read-only flag is its server's word.
